name: DocShelf
description: Read local Markdown, PDF and text docs in tabs. Offline, private, lightweight.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; media-src 'self' blob:; frame-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' blob: data:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
